context_for_next_testing_agent: ESG/Sustainability Dashboard is a new module (Iter 209). All backend endpoints working. Frontend panel shows ESG score (0-100), grade (A+ to D), intensity metrics (kWh/RN, water L/RN, waste kg/RN, CO2 kg/RN), green initiatives grid (10 items), and monthly readings table. Config modal allows setting baselines and toggling initiatives. AI Auto-Quote on Group Requests uses GPT-5.2 and returns intelligent pricing with reasoning. When 'All Branches' is selected, panels default to first property ('default') which may have no data - select specific property like 'aldgate-flats' for testing.
